summary: From blank files you write an MCP server whose one tool reuses execute() from Monday, with the role set by an environment variable and never by the model. A client starts it for four calls and you compare the results with your prediction.
goal: Expose the incident lookup as a tool, from a blank file.

items.text: Write down which of the four calls will be errors and where the role comes from
Write incident_server.py and call_incident_server.py from the contract, without the solution
Run the client and compare the four results with your prediction
Print a line in the server on purpose, see what happens, then fix it
Commit the server and the client
Play the Incident Server Check game to the end and see your score
